calculation.description: For each tradable asset, remove the component of daily return explained by the observation-only DXY return using a trailing 60-day rolling beta, then buy the cross-sectional losers over the trailing five residual-return days. The negative residual shock is a reversal signal. All inputs are lagged/trailing and use no future data.

validation.period: 2020-01-01 to 2029-04-18 (usable observations depend on DXY history)
validation.regime_notes: Full usable panel contained 15 assets and at least 8 valid assets per IC date. 2025-2026: IC 0.08370, ICIR 0.29971, 104 dates; 2027-2028: IC 0.04123, ICIR 0.14512, 521 dates; 2028-01-01 to 2029-04-18: IC 0.02995, ICIR 0.11069, 328 dates. The 2020-2024 regime had no usable dates because the available DXY series did not support the required aligned residual-beta history; it is not treated as evidence of performance.
